changes.before: จะตรวจสอบว่าพัสดุนี้เปลี่ยนสถานที่รับได้ไหมค่ะ ตอนนี้ยังไม่ได้รับใช่ไหมคะ
changes.after: จะตรวจสอบว่าพัสดุนี้เปลี่ยนสถานที่รับได้ไหมคะ ตอนนี้ยังไม่ได้รับใช่ไหมคะ
changes.reason: Use the Thai interrogative polite particle คะ following ไหม; ค่ะ is a declarative particle and is unnatural here.

changes.before: Hai bố mẹ con hãy thử tìm xem đầu lá có nhọn không và mép lá có hình dạng thế nào nhé.
changes.after: Anh/chị và con hãy thử tìm xem đầu lá có nhọn không và mép lá có hình dạng thế nào nhé.
changes.reason: Hai bố mẹ con is an unnatural ambiguous grouping; address the established single parent and child directly without introducing both parents.

changes.before: Cảm ơn anh/chị đã hợp tác. Hai bố mẹ con hãy tiếp tục tận hưởng hoạt động quan sát tiếp theo nhé. Tạm biệt.
changes.after: Cảm ơn anh/chị đã hợp tác. Anh/chị và con hãy tiếp tục tận hưởng hoạt động quan sát tiếp theo nhé. Tạm biệt.
changes.reason: Hai bố mẹ con is an unnatural ambiguous grouping; address the established single parent and child directly without introducing both parents.

changes.before: ध्यान से दोबारा पढ़ने के लिए धन्यवाद। आगे भी प्रदर्शनी का आनंद लीजिए। क्षमा कीजिए।
changes.after: ध्यान से दोबारा पढ़ने के लिए धन्यवाद। आगे भी प्रदर्शनी का आनंद लीजिए। अब मैं अनुमति चाहूँगा।
changes.reason: Closing 失礼します is a polite leave-taking here, not an apology asking forgiveness.

changes.before: Say that you will ask the branch holding your reservation about your current location and where the shoes are stored. Please say it in Japanese.
changes.after: Say that you will tell the branch holding your reservation where you are now and ask where the shoes are being held. Please say it in Japanese.
changes.reason: The player reports being at Central Branch and asks where the shoes are held; the previous hint incorrectly asks the branch about the player’s own location.

changes.before: अभी सोच रहे हैं। मैं खुद चाय तय करने के बजाय उन्हें चुनने के लिए थोड़ा समय दे सकता हूँ?
changes.after: अभी सोच रहे हैं। मैं खुद उनके लिए चाय तय नहीं करना चाहता। क्या आप उन्हें चुनने के लिए थोड़ा समय दे सकते हैं?
changes.reason: Player asks staff to allow the companion time; the old Hindi wording asks whether the player can give time, reversing the request recipient.

changes.before: The creation year is in the column to the right of the number. The artist's description is in a field farther down.
changes.after: The creation year is in the column to the right of the number. Information about the artist is in a field farther down.
changes.reason: 作者の説明 refers to information about the artist here; possessive wording could incorrectly mean a description written by the artist.

changes.before: Thank you. I'll check the year first, then take my time reading the artist's description.
changes.after: Thank you. I'll check the year first, then take my time reading about the artist.
changes.reason: 作者の説明 refers to information about the artist here; possessive wording could incorrectly mean a description written by the artist.

changes.before: Say that you plan to read the creation year and then the artist's description. Say this in Japanese.
changes.after: Say that you plan to check the creation year and then read about the artist. Say this in Japanese.
changes.reason: 作者の説明 refers to information about the artist here; possessive wording could incorrectly mean a description written by the artist.

changes.before: ทำตามลำดับนั้นครับ จบการคุยเท่านี้ ขอบคุณที่เหนื่อยกัน
changes.after: ทำตามลำดับนั้นครับ จบการคุยเท่านี้ ขอบคุณสำหรับความตั้งใจทำงานครับ
changes.reason: お疲れさまでした expresses appreciation for work; thanking people for being tired is an unnatural literal Thai rendering.

changes.before: Mag-alok sa wikang Hapon na magsanay ng pagsasara sa halimbawang payong matapos ang pagpapakita.
changes.after: Sabihin sa wikang Hapon na nais mong magsanay ng pagsasara gamit ang halimbawang payong matapos ang pagpapakita.
changes.reason: The shopper asks to practice after demonstration; mag-alok means offer and misstates the learner’s communicative task.

changes.before: My reservation is for Nagoya, but Osaka is listed at the same time too. Can we board in the order we arrived here?
changes.after: My reservation is for Nagoya, but Osaka is listed at the same time too. Can I board whichever bus arrives here first?
changes.reason: Context asks which bus to board among two destinations, not whether passengers board in their own arrival order.

changes.before: Ask in Japanese whether boarding is by arrival order since two destinations share the same time.
changes.after: Ask in Japanese whether you can board whichever bus arrives first, since two destinations share the same time.
changes.reason: Clarifies that arrival order concerns buses; passenger queue order would change the scenario problem.
